# Initiate a transaction with French checks

Declare each check your merchant receives so Swan can verify it against the FNCI register and process the <Term id="payments">payment</Term>.

:::tip Prerequisites
- Merchant's account status: any except `Closing`, `Suspended`, or `Closed`
- Merchant profile status: `Enabled`
- Check payment method status: `Enabled`
- A project access token, or a user access token with the `canManageAccountMembership` membership permission
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call `initiateCheckMerchantPayment`, completing all mandatory fields: `amount` (`value` and `currency`), `cmc7`, `rlmcKey`, and `merchantProfileId` (lines 2-7).
1. Optionally, add a `label` (shown on the merchant's bank statement; defaults to `Check N°` followed by the first 7 characters of the CMC7) and a `reference` (not shown).
1. Add the `InitiateCheckMerchantPaymentSuccessPayload` (line 10).
1. Add `checkMerchantPayment` to the success payload (line 12).
1. Add the `fnciInfo` to the success payload (lines 15-21). Refer to [French check verification (FNCI)](/payments/concepts/merchants/fnci) for the results and what to do with them.
1. Add `CheckRejection` (line 24), then add the `fnciInfo` (lines 27-33).
1. Add other rejections (not shown).

### Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2-7,10,12,15-21,24,27-33} showLineNumbers
mutation InitiateCheckPayment {
  initiateCheckMerchantPayment(
    input: {
      amount: { value: "50", currency: "EUR" }
      merchantProfileId: "$YOUR_MERCHANT_PROFILE_ID"
      cmc7: "$YOUR_CMC7"
      rlmcKey: "$YOUR_RLMC_KEY"
    }
  ) {
    ... on InitiateCheckMerchantPaymentSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      checkMerchantPayment {
        id
      }
      fnciInfo {
        colorCode
        cpt1
        cpt2
        cpt3
        holderEstablishment
        responseCode
      }
    }
    ... on CheckRejection {
      __typename
      message
      fnciInfo {
        colorCode
        cpt1
        cpt2
        cpt3
        holderEstablishment
        responseCode
      }
    }
  }
}
```

import Environments from '../../../../../_shared/partials/_environments.mdx';

### Payload {#payload}

Note the `colorCode` `GREEN`, meaning the merchant can continue processing this check.

```json {6} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "initiateCheckMerchantPayment": {
      "__typename": "InitiateCheckMerchantPaymentSuccessPayload",
      "fnciInfo": {
        "colorCode": "GREEN",
        "cpt1": 10,
        "cpt2": 32,
        "cpt3": 32,
        "holderEstablishment": "CRCAM NORD DE FRANCE",
        "responseCode": 0
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Next steps {#next}

Swan creates a `CheckIn` <Term id="transactions">transaction</Term> with the status `Upcoming`.
The merchant writes their Swan account number on the back of the check, signs it, and mails it to Swan's check provider, which must receive it within 30 days of this call.
Booking, the [rolling reserve](/payments/concepts/merchants/french-checks#rolling-reserve), and returns follow the [French checks](/payments/concepts/merchants/french-checks#settlement) rules.
